description: Parkeringsplasser i Fredrikstad is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Fredrikstad kommune. Parkeringsplasser i Fredrikstad. Coverage: Fredrikstad kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Fredrikstad kommune. Its keywords include Parkering, Parkeringsplasser, PPlasser, Fredrikstad, fellesDatakatalog, Samferdsel. The listing shows 5 download or service links in CSV, ZIP, GEOJSON, SHP. The listing shows 2018-07-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
